bench.server_state: No live model server or GPU process; stopped capture container retained for provenance.

required_behavior: Atomically claim the named bench and preserve the original claimed_at through any repair.
Heartbeat from a controller-local durable owner and use current inventory SSH identity.
Reuse the resident checkpoint and pinned image without checkpoint rehash or retransmission.
Stage only the scorer plus the frozen capture inputs.
Run a tiny real CUDA discovery call, then continue directly into the single complete component invocation when it passes.
Persist per-arm completion markers outside reported timing, retrieve the typed terminal, and release only after decision-bearing evidence or the absolute deadline.
Expose a hash-bound repair handshake and retain the claim for pre-science CUDA, source, path, layout, import, or retrieval defects.

scientific_contract.mechanism: Exact blockwise or hierarchical maximum-inner-product search with rigorous upper-bound certification and exact rescoring.
scientific_contract.baseline: Strongest dense tied-head CUDA top-1 on the same complete capture.
scientific_contract.correctness: Identical dense top-1 IDs for all 1536 rows and 32 requests, finite scores, complete output consumption, and proof that every skipped block was bounded below the current exact best.
scientific_contract.timing: Warm profiler-off distributions excluding index construction and compilation, but including bound evaluation, traversal, and exact rescoring. Report index construction and amortization separately.
scientific_contract.positive: Complete candidate warm latency is lower than 0.004182975769042969 seconds with a credible resident-index path.
scientific_contract.negative: A correct complete candidate that prunes too little or is not faster closes only this block-bound mechanism.

repair_and_release.pre_science: Retain the original claim and repair mutable implementation boundaries while the closest corrected retry plus terminal and release fits the absolute deadline.
repair_and_release.post_science: Do not replay the complete invocation. Construct or retrieve the terminal from immutable raw artifacts when only serialization or retrieval fails.
repair_and_release.release: Release available after a decision-bearing terminal and zero GPU occupants; release maintenance with exact state only for unsafe/unreachable guest or absolute deadline.
